text:
elaine: seeing a weird pattern: websocket clients for shared-tenant routes are reconnecting and generating duplicate charge events. console shows two distinct resume counts for same session id occasionally.

siva: do we have an example trace? looks similar to the sticky-route flip we had, but that was SSE not ws.

elain e: example trace id 0xabc123 in prod: client dropped -> reconnect -> resume accepted on new shard, but old shard didn't garbage-collect quickly and emitted a final close event which the billing pipeline interpreted as another resume pair.

tom: ah, so billing dedupe relies on a short tombstone on the shard. if tombstone TTL > client reconnect window, we should be fine; if < then we risk double-count. what TTL are we running?

siva: default tombstone ttl is 5s for ws shards, but the new route affinity rollout lowered it to 1s for fast failover. that may be too low for flaky mobile clients.

elain e: console UX shows a spike in resume_error and billing_duplicate_count right after the route affinity flag flip. timeline matches.

ops-bot: note: created INC-4221 "ws tombstone TTL too short on fast-affinity" and assigned to siva.

siva: quick mitigation: bump ttl to 6s for canary routes, and add a metric `ws_resume_dedupe_gap` = count(duplicate_resume_events) / total_resumes per minute so we can monitor during rollout.

tom: also propose changing billing pipeline to join on session_id + time-window instead of naive resume pair. small change: extend dedupe window by 2x and prefer post-close resume that has active KV state.

elain e: for console: add a panel that shows tombstone_ttl, resume_retries, and duplicate_charge_rate per route so PMs can see the impact of affinity tuning.

siva: done for mitigation. rolling TTL bump to 6s for canary now. will monitor for rollback triggers.

release-bot: rollout:route-affinity-canary updated (tombstone_ttl=6s) 1:03 UTC.

elain e: after 3m dup charges dropped ~90% on the canary. looks good. follow-ups: (1) add preflight test that simulates flaky reconnects across the two proxy paths, (2) surface dedupe window in console docs, (3) add billing-side join on session id/time as tom suggested.

tom: i'll open PR for the billing join and a short note in the rollout checklist: "verify shard tombstone TTL vs expected reconnect distribution".

siva: i'll add the preflight harness to infra tests. thanks all. :thumbsup:
